epifoundation.corpus: Declared as more than 100,000 paired single-cell RNA-ATAC profiles from 19 tissues and 56 cell types; no immutable checkpoint-bound accession/sample/donor manifest was recovered.
epifoundation.corpus_annotation_state: paired multimodal pretraining with cell-type and batch labels available in companion vocabularies and supervised downstream paths

interpretation: EpiFoundation is a paired RNA-ATAC foundation model with an exact weight identity, but it remains fail-closed. Its source repository has no detected license, the 3.6-GB checkpoint is pickle-formatted, the checkpoint-bound configuration and corpus accessions are unresolved, and native cell embeddings require observed ATAC. GSE244832, GSE281367, GSE289173, and GSE296875 all remain exposure-unknown: public-release dates do not establish when biological material or data entered an undocumented pretraining collection. Independently, it cannot enter the current RNA-only held-back cell-state task, RNA-conditioned ATAC endpoint, or signed variant-effect endpoint.
remaining_blockers: Obtain written permission covering execution, adaptation, and redistribution of the pinned unlicensed repository code, plus institutional confirmation of allowed weight and derivative-weight uses.

Recover an immutable checkpoint-bound accession/sample/donor corpus and collection-timeline manifest. Until then retain unknown exposure for GSE244832, GSE281367, GSE289173, and GSE296875 and keep the model champion-ineligible.

With explicit future acquisition approval, verify the checkpoint size, SHA-256, Xet pointer, and every companion vocabulary hash before networkless restricted inspection; never use unrestricted torch.load or restore optimizer, scheduler, or scaler state.

Bind exact checkpoint state keys, tensor shapes/dtypes, architecture, maximum lengths, dropout, masks, special tokens, chromosome labels, and all vocabulary orders; resolve the conflicting pretraining and evaluation configs before conversion to tensor-only safetensors.

Freeze deterministic ATAC and RNA tokenization, long-row truncation, data-loader worker seeds, out-of-vocabulary and missingness semantics, native genome/annotation identities, and mappings to GRCh38.p14/GENCODE v49.

Validate the declared Python 3.8.19, Torch 2.1.1, CUDA 12.1, FlashAttention 2.6.3 path on L40S for import, safe checkpoint conversion, forward/backward, resume, determinism, memory, and numeric tolerances.

Create a separate nonpromotable observed-ATAC TaskSpec before any scoring. GSE244832 remains donor-matched different aliquot, and no native EpiFoundation result may be relabeled as RNA-conditioned ATAC prediction.
